scope: Substantive release evidence checklist, not legal clearance; unverified legal applicability, inventory gaps and provenance risks are reported by the gate, not cleared

residual_risks.risk: Two NPM package locations lack applicable full legal texts: @humanfs/types 0.15.0 and the nested @tybys/wasm-util 0.10.3; their locked tarballs and matching source commits carry only metadata labels, and no actual-bundle evidence places them outside the release payload. Six further locations now carry version-pinned upstream texts with recorded limits (natural-compare keeps a linked author text, not a version-tarball LICENSE; @rolldown/binding-win32-x64-msvc 1.2.19 and @tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi 4.3.5 are tag-corresponding, not native/WASI build correspondence).

Actual three-target native compiler, CGO support-library and runtime legal texts are not reconciled with the emitted binaries, and no per-target evidence confirms that the bundled Web assets and the prebuilt WASI payload's applicable notices are present in the release payload.

MPL-2.0 corresponding source access is recorded only as upstream locations; covered-source correspondence, local modifications and any required modified-source delivery for the actual release build remain unverified.

deferred.risk: The embedded AVIF v0.6.0 prebuilt WASM is bound only by payload and recipe hashes; its exact upstream libavif/AOM/dav1d/libyuv revisions, WASI SDK/compiler/runtime inputs and any source modifications are unmapped. Payload presence and recorded legal texts are not provenance.
No reproducible-build or signed-attestation record ties the published binaries to the recorded source inputs and toolchain.
